new_categories.label: terminal_dry_bulk_runoff_drainage_assurance_readiness
new_categories.memory: A terminal dry-bulk runoff/drainage assurance state can be represented separately from berth-transfer readiness, storage/reclaim readiness and downstream environmental outcome.

new_categories.label: runoff_source_scope_confidence
new_categories.memory: Runoff or material-loss source scope can be bounded to a berth, transfer-point, stockyard or storage area without retaining exact layouts, drains, flows or cargo locations.

new_categories.label: terminal_drainage_path_availability
new_categories.memory: Drainage-path availability can be represented separately from source condition, collection condition and final environmental-boundary confidence.

new_categories.label: sediment_material_loss_collection_readiness
new_categories.memory: A non-specific sediment or cargo-material collection readiness state can be retained without exact basins, sumps, traps, quantities or treatment arrangements.

new_categories.label: runoff_containment_boundary_confidence
new_categories.memory: Confidence that runoff and entrained material remain within an intended collection/containment scope can be modeled separately from path availability or collection readiness.

new_categories.label: environmental_boundary_monitoring_confidence
new_categories.memory: A non-numeric monitoring-confidence state can represent whether the intended terminal/environmental boundary is being observed without retaining exact monitor locations, values, limits or alarm logic.

new_categories.label: drainage_service_margin_confidence
new_categories.memory: Useful drainage/collection service margin can be represented qualitatively as adequate, uncertain or restricted without retaining exact flow, capacity, precipitation, storage or treatment values.

new_categories.label: source_to_collection_path_continuity_confidence
new_categories.memory: End-to-end continuity from bounded runoff source scope through drainage path to collection/containment can degrade even when individual components appear available.

new_categories.label: runoff_drainage_support_dependency_confidence
new_categories.memory: Delivered drainage assurance can depend on bounded power, pumping, gate/valve, monitoring, cleaning or other support states that can degrade separately from the physical drainage path; exact equipment is deferred.

new_categories.label: runoff_drainage_degradation_lifecycle
new_categories.memory: Runoff/drainage assurance can move through available, degraded, restricted, isolated, under-verification and restored states with separate timestamps.

new_categories.label: scoped_runoff_restriction_and_isolation
new_categories.memory: Restriction or isolation can attach to a source zone, drainage segment, collection scope, containment boundary, monitoring path or support dependency rather than the entire terminal.

new_categories.label: downstream_environmental_effect_not_root_cause_proof
new_categories.memory: Cargo-area restriction, cleanup concern, material loss, environmental-assurance concern, throughput uncertainty, rehandling or schedule effects do not by themselves prove a drainage-path, collection, containment or monitoring root cause.

new_categories.label: multi_timestamp_runoff_drainage_restoration
new_categories.memory: Drainage-path recovery, collection readiness, containment confidence, monitoring verification, restriction release and return to normal cargo-area assurance can occur at different times.

useful_refinements.label: stormwater_runoff_vs_cargo_spill_containment
useful_refinements.memory: Terminal runoff/drainage assurance should remain distinct from direct cargo-spill containment even where both use collection boundaries or drainage paths.

useful_refinements.label: runoff_drainage_vs_dust_environmental_boundary
useful_refinements.memory: P131-type airborne dust environmental-boundary assurance is different from runoff/drainage/material-loss boundary assurance; one can remain satisfactory while the other is degraded.

useful_refinements.label: runoff_drainage_vs_storage_reclaim_readiness
useful_refinements.memory: P130 storage/reclaim service can be available while drainage/material-loss assurance is restricted, and drainage degradation does not by itself establish a storage/reclaim root cause.

useful_refinements.label: delivered_drainage_service_vs_terminal_infrastructure
useful_refinements.memory: Long-horizon terminal land/infrastructure availability does not establish the delivered runoff/drainage collection service state at a particular operating scope.

duplicates.label: generic_service_monitoring_support_lifecycle_pattern
duplicates.memory: Generic monitoring-confidence, support-dependency, degradation/restriction/isolation and restoration mechanics repeat campaign-wide service-state patterns.

duplicates.label: generic_downstream_effect_separation_pattern
duplicates.memory: Generic separation of downstream operational/environmental effects from root-cause proof is already campaign-wide.

stop_reason: The bounded terminal dry-bulk runoff/drainage/material-loss assurance questions are answered; further recall trends toward exact layouts, flows, capacities, discharge limits, treatment settings, permit/compliance rules, procedures, providers or incidents that require Evidence.
epistemic_boundary: Memory-only defensive terminal dry-bulk runoff/drainage/material-loss containment orientation and source-discovery output; not stormwater, drainage, environmental-compliance, treatment, cleanup, maintenance or emergency guidance and not proof of any exact layout, flow, capacity, value, limit, setting, procedure, provider, incident or current-readiness fact.
